chat.key: I'm writing this because I don't hear people speaking about this enough.    There is definitely something going on in the US. Since November, the UAP (unidentified aerial phenomenon) activity has been increasing, and it's almost a norm in some cities (NJ for example) to spot these UAPs daily in the night sky.    Now here is the thing. The government is not able to identify these yet they say that "these drones are not a threat". How is that even possible?

Recently, there was a cyber truck exploding in front of Trump Tower and an email was sent to an intelligence officer. This released email linked this event to the UAP phenomenon. The main message was that the drones in the US are Chinese and use antigravitational propulsion.    I can't help but feel something serious is about to go down.
